name: Tinker: Upgrade! turns the standing Sentry Turret into a Molten Grenade Turret (#9951)
contract: Upgrade! 800349 reads 'Upgrade nearby Sentry Turrets to a Molten Grenade Turret for $706692d.' #9951 reported
that casting it with a turret out does nothing. spell_ascension_tinker_ability casts Molten Grenade Turret 706692
(60 s, ranged and spell haste) on every owned Sentry Turret 50046 within 40 yards, and an upgraded turret fires
Molten Grenade 706694 at its focus target instead of Sentry Shot 706689. 706692 has TargetAuraSpell 750001
(Sentry Turret Hidden Identifier), so the turret must carry that aura or the triggered cast fails silently.
Expected at level 45 with the turret already firing at a hostile target: the cast is accepted, the turret carries
706692, Molten Grenades land on the target, and Sentry Shots stop while the upgrade lasts.
Not covered here: the turret's appearance. The aura's transform effect is cleared in AscensionTinkerContracts
because its creature 3313900 does not exist, so an upgraded turret looks unchanged.

steps.label: Let the spawn and level scaling settle
SETUP: give the turret a focus target
SETUP: the Sentry Turret is landing Sentry Shots

CONTRACT: the turret becomes a Molten Grenade Turret
SETUP: Molten Grenade impacts before the upgrade fires
CONTRACT: the upgraded turret lands Molten Grenades on its target
SETUP: Sentry Shot impacts once grenades are landing
Let the upgraded turret attack several more times
CONTRACT: the upgraded turret fires no Sentry Shots
